newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Volga-Dnepr 1996 air cargo sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Russian Volga-Dnepr 1996 air cargo sales rise.

text.p: Russian private cargo airline Volga-Dnepr boosted sales in 1996 to $111 million from $87.2 million in 1995, the company said on Monday.
Volga-Dnepr spokesman Konstantin Rogov told Reuters that the airline carried 45,100 tonnes of cargo last year, compared to 39,633 tonnes in 1995.

"Most of last year's sales were made on Antonov-124 freighter operations. It gave us $101.4 million of our total sales volume," he said, adding that these aircraft carried 40,000 tonnes of cargo over 1996.
Volga-Dnepr operates seven Antonov-124 planes, each with a capacity of 120 tonnes, three Ilyushin-76s, one Antonov-12 and one Antonov-32.
The company also operates a regular passenger route between Ulyanovsk, in central Russia, and Moscow, using a Yakovlev-40.
